scenarios.location: Medical-surgical floor at a busy hour
scenarios.problem: Every device shares the 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz bands with older equipment and neighbouring units, so capacity runs short when the floor is busiest.
scenarios.outcomeSupported: Moving capable devices to 6 GHz frees capacity in the older bands and gives imaging and video wider, cleaner channels.

scenarios.problem: A nurse's badge call stutters when a large imaging upload fills the one band the badge is connected to.
scenarios.outcomeSupported: With multi-link operation, the call's packets can use a less busy band, supporting steadier calls on the move.

scenarios.problem: Another system is busy in one small slice of the wide channel, and the access point has to fall back to a much narrower channel.
scenarios.outcomeSupported: Puncturing and Multi-RU let the access point keep using most of the channel, supporting faster image transfers in the room.

scenarios.problem: Devices share a long-lived WPA2 passphrase; a recorded sign-in could be attacked offline without anyone noticing.
scenarios.outcomeSupported: WPA3 sign-in and per-session keys make offline guessing ineffective and limit what a leaked password exposes, supporting the organisation's wider security programme.

scenarios.location: Inpatient unit across a long shift
scenarios.problem: Small battery-powered devices keep their radios listening and need recharging or swapping before the shift ends.
scenarios.outcomeSupported: Target Wake Time lets devices sleep between agreed wake-ups, and Restricted TWT protects time for voice and telemetry, supporting longer battery life and dependable delivery.

scenarios.problem: Two shifts of staff devices plus patient equipment and visitors' phones all compete for the same airtime at once.
scenarios.outcomeSupported: Serving several devices per transmission and spreading them across bands supports a responsive network at the unit's busiest moments.

scenarios.problem: Occasionally an alarm message waits behind a large download before reaching the nurses' station.
scenarios.outcomeSupported: Multi-link operation, Restricted TWT and Multi-RU target those worst-case waits, supporting more consistent delivery of alarms and voice.

scenarios.problem: New access points are planned for switch ports and power budgets that were sized for earlier generations.
scenarios.outcomeSupported: Planning multi-gigabit uplinks and PoE budgets with the access points supports getting the full benefit of Wi-Fi 7 from day one.
